headline: As of 2026-10-22: 18,618,563 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 45 of 50 states, D+13.8 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 18,618,563 early/mail ballots cast so far across 45 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+13.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (2,264,525), California (1,962,985), Florida (1,682,821).
